issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency: In template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java the method is declared as appendElement(T[] array, T element) (lines 13-17), but template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(this.stockIngredients, ingredient) (lines 18-20). The solution repository implements addElementToArray(T[] array, T element) (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java, lines 13-17). This mismatch causes a compilation error for the template project because the called method name does not exist in the provided ArrayHelpers, blocking students from building or running the project.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers method name consistent across the template and solution. Prefer renaming the method in the template from appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) (matching the solution and existing calls in Stock.java). Alternatively, update calls in Stock.java to use appendElement(...), but renaming ArrayHelpers to addElementToArray is recommended to align with the solution and the rest of the codebase.

issues.description: The array-append helper method is named inconsistently across artifacts. The template's ArrayHelpers class declares a method named appendElement(T[], T) (template: ArrayHelpers.appendElement), while the template's Stock class calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...) (template: Stock.addToStockIngredients uses addElementToArray). The solution repository's ArrayHelpers provides addElementToArray(T[], T) (solution: ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray). Because the template both defines appendElement and calls addElementToArray (which does not exist in the template), students will encounter a compilation error and cannot clearly map the problem guidance (which suggests using ArrayHelpers) to the available API.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the identifier for the array-append helper. Either rename the template method appendElement(T[] array, T element) to addElementToArray(T[] array, T element), or change the call in Stock.addToStockIngredients to call appendElement(...). Ensure both the template and solution use the exact same method name (preferably addElementToArray to match the solution) so students can compile the project and map the API to the problem guidance.
